Hi, I'm Bram, and I'm a sound engineer from Rotterdam. I have worked on four world tours. I have been to more than forty countries, but I have seen almost nothing of them: only airports, hotels and stadiums. My job is to make the music sound good for the crowd, from the first row to the last. The most difficult place? Old stadiums, with a lot of echo. The best moment of my career? I have heard seventy thousand people sing along to one song, with no music, only voices. I have never forgotten it. People ask me: have you ever met the band? Yes, I have. They are very normal people.

Hello, I'm Lucy, and music is my big passion. I have seen Coldplay live five times, in three different countries. The first time was in London, in 2012, and I cried during the last song. I have traveled to Paris and to Madrid only for their concerts. My friends think I'm crazy. I have also seen U2 once, in a stadium in Dublin. It was raining, but nobody cared. But I have never seen Dua Lipa. My daughter loves her, so I'm going to take her to a concert next year. It's going to be her first concert, and my first time as a mother in the crowd.
